feeds.title: Clean the World Blog
feeds.description: The Clean the World blog also relates to circular economy principles by showing how waste materials can be reused instead of discarded. By collecting and recycling hotel soap and amenities, the organization closes the loop, turning what would be waste into new, valuable products. This reduces environmental impact, minimizes landfill contributions, and promotes resource efficiency. It demonstrates a practical circular economy model in the hospitality sector, where materials are kept in use for as long as possible, and social and environmental benefits are combined.
